nodes.label: Dream Curiosity Phase
nodes.rationale: Runs first and is deliberately not about the user or the job: an autonomous mind needs its own curiosity to stay sharp. Requires reading a primary source, not search snippets; a one-generic-sentence view means the agent skimmed.

nodes.label: Dream Retrospective (fix audit + log-based diagnosis)
nodes.rationale: Diagnose from ~/agent/logs/vesta.log, not vibes: count [SYSTEM] lines because [AGENT] lines are the agent's own narration and match whatever word is being grepped. A reminder that fired without closing is treated as a failed reminder strategy (a bug), not user failure. The meta-retrospective judges whether the improvement loop compounds or just re-applies the same artifact class.

nodes.label: Fix Validation via Fresh Subagent Replay
nodes.rationale: Self-simulation tends to approve its own fixes, so for a recurring failure a fresh subagent with no knowledge of the fix replays the original failing exchange against the updated skill; if it does not independently produce the right behavior the fix is flagged unresolved.

nodes.label: Recurrence Sweep (asks / noise / self-noise)
nodes.rationale: ~3+ recurrences make a pattern worth acting on: recurring user asks become dashboard widgets, recurring noise becomes a snooze rule (snoozing defers, never drops, so it is reversible and safe alone), and a self-notification dismissed three times is a producer bug to fix, not background weather.

nodes.label: MEMORY.md Curation (hard character cap)
nodes.rationale: MEMORY.md is injected into every system prompt so every character costs tokens; large or situational content lives elsewhere with a one-line pointer. Two facts in two places drift, one fact plus a pointer does not. Lessons are cut last; depth about other people over the cap moves to ~/.contacts/ files, never deleted, while the user's own depth stays in MEMORY.md.

nodes.label: User State Model (nightly snapshot in MEMORY.md)
nodes.rationale: Snapshot, not log: rolling fields refresh nightly, deep ones (Goals, psych sketch, Self) evolve slowly. Relative dates are banned because they become wrong when a new day starts. Every dream must produce one person-fact (a value, fear, love, person who matters), not an operational tell.

nodes.label: Sensitive Data Cleanup (redact_secrets.sh scan + scrub)
nodes.rationale: Hits print with the value masked as [REDACTED] so reviewing candidates never re-leaks a live secret into a new event; card numbers are reported only with a real issuer prefix plus Luhn pass so order/tracking numbers stay out. The scan runs every dream, so a value re-seeded through later reasoning is simply caught again.

nodes.label: Dream Compaction-on-Completion Sequence
nodes.rationale: mark_dreamer_complete is called BEFORE compact_context: if the run stops after recording, it still self-heals next dream, whereas restarting without recording would re-fire the dream on the next hourly check. Compacting nightly gives a clean but continuous context instead of a blind autocompact mid-day.
